cards.flavorEn: One moment you think clouds are drifting past; the next, claws and fangs leap out of them. The perfect ambush.
cards.flavorJa:
雲が漂っていると思った次の瞬間には、
そこから爪や牙が飛び出してくるわけだ。最高の奇襲だよ。
translationNotes: Unofficial English name, family names, and gameplay-text translation; the Japanese original and current rulings control.

cards.flavorEn:
Apparently, its head once had skin and flesh. It is said that repeated charges left it in this state.
—From the Stranger’s Travelogue
cards.flavorJa:
元々の頭には皮膚も肉もあったらしい。
繰り返される突撃の果てにこの姿になったのだとか。
―異邦者の千里録より
translationNotes: Unofficial English title and translation; Burukureiten is a romanization of ブルクレイテン.
Family mappings: 暗紫 = Dark Purple; 屍骸 = Corpse.

cards.flavorEn: “No tricks or gimmicks here!”
cards.flavorJa: 「タネも仕掛けもございませ～ん」
translationNotes: Unofficial English title and translation; Papirioni is a romanization of パピリオーニ. 諜蝶 combines espionage and butterfly imagery.
Spirit Manipulation is an unofficial English rendering of 操霊; no official translation was found in the supplied Standard English manuals.
The Spirit Manipulation text does not say to Summon without paying the cost; this is preserved as printed.
Family mappings: 暗紫 = Dark Purple; 幻妖 = Phantom.

cards.flavorEn: Do not be distracted by the masses surging toward you. Aim for the most effective strike.
cards.flavorJa: 押し寄せる物量に惑わされず、もっとも効果的な一撃を狙うのだ。

cards.flavorEn: It is destined for more than ruling the crimson skies. One day, it will command the skies of the entire world.
cards.flavorJa: 赤き空の覇者にとどまる器ではない。いずれは全世界の空を支配するだろう。
translationNotes: Unofficial English name, family names, and gameplay-text translation; the Japanese original and current rulings control.
Fanciful proper name is rendered provisionally in Roman letters; no official English spelling is asserted.
The printed Succession reminder uses EX symbols as shorthand; this translation specifies the cards bearing those symbols, consistent with Standard comprehensive rule 12-2-1-3.

cards.illustratorJa: イラスト：ハヤケン・サレナ
cards.flavorEn: Merely facing it is extraordinarily difficult. Opposing it would be a monumental challenge.
cards.flavorJa: 向き合うだけでも困難極まる。対抗するのは至難だろう。
translationNotes: Unofficial English title and translation; Shi Rezen is a romanization of シ・レーゼン. 蟲爵 is rendered Insect Noble without assigning a specific noble rank.
Spirit Manipulation is an unofficial English rendering of 操霊; no official translation was found in the supplied Standard English manuals.
Family mappings: 暗紫 = Dark Purple; 業魔 = Karmic Demon.

cards.flavorEn: It is both a collective and an individual.
cards.flavorJa: 群れであると同時に個体でもある。
translationNotes: Unofficial English title and translation; Danpirion is a romanization of ダンピリオン, and 公 is rendered Duke.
Family mapping: 血醒 = Awakened Blood.
Succession is a cost reduction procedure; its printed reminder is translated here.

cards.flavorEn: Its cuteness will burn you, body and soul.
cards.flavorJa: その可愛らしさに身も心も焼かれてしまう。
translationNotes: Unofficial English name, family names, and gameplay-text translation; the Japanese original and current rulings control.
Fanciful proper name is rendered provisionally in Roman letters; no official English spelling is asserted.

cards.flavorEn: "This place belongs to us from today on. Got a problem with that?"
cards.flavorJa: 「ここいらは今日からアタイ達のモンだよ。文句あんのかい?」
translationNotes: 泥濘招きの is translated as the Mire Beckoner.
Heavy Exhausted Spirits are treated as Exhausted under the official rules; the first effect retains the printed condition Exhausted, while the second explicitly excludes Heavy Exhausted Spirits.

cards.flavorEn: Whenever the water runs red, this creature is always at its center.
cards.flavorJa: 水中が赤く染まっている時、その中心には必ずコイツがいるんだ。
translationNotes: Buzzsorn is an unofficial romanization of バズソーン. 八つ裂き is translated as the Dismemberer.
The printed Succession reminder refers to removing EX Symbols; the English makes explicit the official manual’s rule that the cards bearing those symbols are removed from the game.

cards.flavorEn: Within the nest, the light of new life had kindled.
cards.flavorJa: 巣の中では新たな命の灯がともっていた。
translationNotes: Unofficial English name, family names, and gameplay-text translation; the Japanese original and current rulings control.

cards.flavorEn: The master of the ocean trench has awakened...
cards.flavorJa: 海溝の主が目覚めた――。
translationNotes: Leviaclan is an unofficial romanization of レヴィアクラン. 海神 is translated as the Sea God.
古蛟 is provisionally translated as Ancient Water Dragon.
The printed Succession reminder refers to removing EX Symbols; the English makes explicit the official manual’s rule that the cards bearing those symbols are removed from the game.

cards.flavorEn: With a sword fastened in place of its lost foot, it returns to the battlefield… Seeing it fight so desperately reminds me of the warriors of that world. —From the Stranger’s Travelogue.
cards.flavorJa:
失った足の代わりに剣を繋いで戦地へ戻る……
必死に戦う姿はあの世界の戦士達を思い出させる。
―異邦者の千里録より
translationNotes: Unofficial English name, family names, and gameplay-text translation; the Japanese original and current rulings control.
Fanciful proper name is rendered provisionally in Roman letters; no official English spelling is asserted.

cards.flavorEn: The small build that had earned the scorn of its kin became a valuable asset in the assassination trade.
cards.flavorJa: 同胞から見下されてきた小柄な身体は、暗殺業では有用な長所となった。
translationNotes: Unofficial English title and translation; Nidori is a romanization of ニドリー.
Family mappings: 暗紫 = Dark Purple; 獣憑 = Beast Possession.

cards.illustratorJa:
コンセプト：丸山浩
イラスト：かんくろう
cards.flavorEn: Even among the dogs of Dark Purple, this is one of the most dangerous.
cards.flavorJa: 暗紫の犬の中でも危険極まる部類に入る。
translationNotes: Unofficial English title and translation; Gasha is romanized from ガシャ, and ハウンド is rendered Hound.
Family mappings: 暗紫 = Dark Purple; 屍骸 = Corpse.

cards.flavorEn: Its wrinkled face reveals nothing of whether it is angry or sad.
cards.flavorJa:
怒っているのか悲しんでいるのか、
しわだらけの表情からは何も読み取れない。
translationNotes: Unofficial English title and translation; Garudi is a romanization of ガルディー.
Family mappings: 暗紫 = Dark Purple; 変異 = Mutation.

cards.illustratorJa: イラスト：イシバシヨウスケ
cards.flavorEn:
In the former world, two-headed dogs lived alongside flame, but here they seem to oppose it.
—From the Stranger’s Travelogue
cards.flavorJa:
かつての世界で双頭の犬は炎と共に在ったが、
ここでは炎と敵対しているようだ。
―異邦者の千里録より
translationNotes: Unofficial English title and translation; Irurion is a romanization of イルリオン.
Family mappings: 暗紫 = Dark Purple; 変異 = Mutation.

cards.illustratorEn: Credit retained in supplied original card image
translationNotes: Unofficial name and English effect text from the approved review catalog; the printed original face remains Japanese.

cards.flavorEn: Flames make no distinction. They simply consume.
cards.flavorJa: 炎は何も区別しない。ただ呑み込むだけだ。
translationNotes: Unofficial English name, family names, and gameplay-text translation; the Japanese original and current rulings control.

cards.flavorEn: Thieving skills honed to perfection are now indistinguishable from magic.
cards.flavorJa: 磨き抜かれた盗みの技術は、もはや魔法と区別がつかない。
translationNotes: Unofficial English title and translation; グランドセフト is rendered Grand Theft.
Family mapping: 暗紫 = Dark Purple.
The Life-loss condition changes only the number selected; both selected Spirits must meet the printed exactly-1-core condition.

cards.flavorEn: Sea Green bubbles change to suit their purpose. You can even make them as hard as a shield.
cards.flavorJa:
海緑の泡は用途に合わせて変化するんだ。
盾のように硬くすることだってできるよ。

cards.flavorEn: The weapons of Blue Tree need no forging. The weapons themselves grow.
cards.flavorJa: 青樹の武器は鍛える必要が無い。武器自らが成長するのだ。
translationNotes: Unofficial English title and translation; シャープソーン is rendered Sharp Thorn.
Family mapping: 青樹 = Blue Tree.

cards.flavorEn: “My sisters! If you refuse to retreat, I cannot show you mercy!”
cards.flavorJa: 「妹達よ!　引かぬなら容赦はできんぞ!」
translationNotes: Unofficial English name, family names, and gameplay-text translation; the Japanese original and current rulings control.
Fanciful proper name is rendered provisionally in Roman letters; no official English spelling is asserted.

cards.flavorEn: The phoenix of skies dyed crimson, a being cloaked in tempered flame.
cards.flavorJa: 紅に染まる空の凰にして、煉られし炎を纏う存在。
translationNotes: Unofficial English name, family names, and gameplay-text translation; the Japanese original and current rulings control.
Fanciful proper name is rendered provisionally in Roman letters; no official English spelling is asserted.

Soul Awakening is an unofficial translation of the printed keyword ソウル覚醒. Its player-wide once-per-turn restriction and the separate same-name effect restriction are both retained. Standard comprehensive rule 5-4-1 defines 自身 as the player.
The printed Succession reminder uses EX symbols as shorthand; this translation specifies the cards bearing those symbols, consistent with Standard comprehensive rule 12-2-1-3.

cards.illustratorJa: イラスト：株式会社スタジオヴィガ
cards.flavorEn: “Too bad, but it looks like I’ll be the last one standing...”
cards.flavorJa: 「残念だけど、最後に立っているのは私になりそうね……」
translationNotes: Unofficial English title and translation; Rindorin is a romanization of リンドリン, and 紫苑 is rendered Aster.
Family mappings: 暗紫 = Dark Purple; 刀華 = Bladeflower; 血醒 = Awakened Blood.

cards.flavorEn: “I shall receive the retreating people of Dark Purple in my castle... The wounded are especially welcome.”
cards.flavorJa:
「撤退してくる暗紫の者は我が居城で受け入れよう……
怪我をしているものは特に歓迎するぞ」
translationNotes: Unofficial English title and translation; Kuramagurama is a romanization of クラマグラマ.
Family mappings: 暗紫 = Dark Purple; 血醒 = Awakened Blood.
Succession is a cost reduction procedure; its printed reminder is translated here.

cards.illustratorJa:
コンセプト：石垣純哉
イラスト：石垣純哉
cards.flavorEn:
The purple sword stroke had summoned a primordial demon. A fiend bringing pestilence had manifested in this world.
—From the Stranger’s Travelogue
cards.flavorJa:
紫の太刀筋が招いたのは原初の魔。疫病を引き連れた悪鬼がこの世界に顕現していた。
―異邦者の千里録より
translationNotes: Unofficial English title and translation; デスペラード is rendered Desperado, and 魔界七将 is rendered the Demon Realm’s Seven Generals.
Family mappings: 暗紫 = Dark Purple; 夜族 = Nightkin; 呪鬼 = Cursed Demon.
Succession is a cost reduction procedure; its printed reminder is translated here.
The summon effect selects 3 total, does not say “up to,” and prints a gain of 1 core rather than 1 per Depleted Spirit. The Lv2 effect leaves 1 non-Soul Core; it does not move the Soul Core.

cards.flavorEn: The form Taiga Hanaya takes after transforming and leveling up with the Gamer Driver and Bang Bang Shooting Gashat.
cards.flavorJa:
花家大我がゲーマドライバーとバンバンシューティングガシャットを
用いて変身・レベルアップした姿。
translationNotes: Level Up is a fan translation of レベルアップ. Official FAQ Q31733-Q31734 clarifies that the first attack/block is counted among your Spirits, not among the opponent's attacks. cards.flavorEn: The form Kiriya Kujo takes after transforming and leveling up with the Gamer Driver and Bakusou Bike Gashat.
cards.flavorJa:
九条貴利矢がゲーマドライバーと爆走バイクガシャットを
用いて変身・レベルアップした姿。

cards.flavorEn: The form Emu Hojo takes after transforming and leveling up with the Gamer Driver and Mighty Action X Gashat.
cards.flavorJa:
宝生永夢がゲーマドライバーとマイティアクションXガシャットを用いて
変身・レベルアップした姿。

cards.flavorEn: The form Taiga Hanaya takes after transforming and leveling up with the Gamer Driver, Bang Bang Shooting Gashat, and Drago Knight Hunter Z Gashat.
cards.flavorJa:
花家大我がゲーマドライバーとバンバンシューティングガシャット、
ドラゴナイトハンターZガシャットを用いて変身・レベルアップした姿。

cards.flavorEn: The form Hiiro Kagami takes after transforming and leveling up with the Gamer Driver and Taddle Quest Gashat.
cards.flavorJa:
鏡飛彩がゲーマドライバーとタドルクエストガシャットを
用いて変身・レベルアップした姿。

cards.flavorEn: The form Poppy Pipopapo takes after transforming with the Buggle Driver II and Tokimeki Crisis Gashat.
cards.flavorJa:
ポッピーピポパポがバグルドライバーIIと
ときめきクライシスガシャットを用いて変身した姿。
translationNotes: Unstackable, Once per turn follows official English Comprehensive Rules section 12-3-3; separate copies can each activate once at different timings. Tokimeki is the romanization of ときめき used for this review; an official English Battle Spirits localization was not verified.

cards.flavorEn: The form Hiiro Kagami takes after transforming with the Gamer Driver and Gashat Gear Dual Beta.
cards.flavorJa: 鏡飛彩がゲーマドライバーとガシャットギア デュアルベータを用いて変身した姿。
translationNotes: Level Up is a fan translation of レベルアップ. Official FAQ Q31733-Q31734 clarifies that the first attack/block is counted among your Spirits, not among the opponent's attacks. cards.flavorEn: The form Taiga Hanaya takes after transforming with the Gamer Driver and Gashat Gear Dual Beta.
cards.flavorJa:
花家大我がゲーマドライバーとガシャットギア デュアルベータを用いて
変身した姿。

cards.flavorEn: The form Emu Hojo takes after transforming with the Gamer Driver and Maximum Mighty X Gashat.
cards.flavorJa:
宝生永夢がゲーマドライバーとマキシマムマイティXガシャットを用いて
変身した姿。
translationNotes: F Change is a fan translation of Fチェンジ. The quoted Ex-Aid condition is a card-name substring, while EX-AID is a family. Official FAQ Q31730 confirms that the return-to-hand action cannot be performed unless a qualifying card can be summoned; the mandatory summon is retained. Source: https://www.battlespirits.com/faq/list.php?freeword=F%E3%83%81%E3%82%A7%E3%83%B3%E3%82%B8&format=eternal

cards.flavorEn: The game company Masamune Dan built in a single generation, commanding the largest share of the domestic market. His great ambition was to complete the ultimate game, Kamen Rider Chronicle, and launch it worldwide.
cards.flavorJa:
檀正宗が一代で築き上げた国内シェアトップのゲーム会社。
究極のゲーム「仮面ライダークロニクル」の完成と世界展開が正宗の
大きな目標であった。

cards.flavorEn: The form Parado takes after transforming with the Gamer Driver and Gashat Gear Dual.
cards.flavorJa: パラドがゲーマドライバーとガシャットギア デュアルを用いて変身した姿。
translationNotes: Level Up is a fan translation of レベルアップ. Official FAQ Q31733-Q31734 clarifies that the first attack/block is counted among your Spirits, not among the opponent's attacks. Source: https://www.battlespirits.com/faq/list.php?freeword=%E3%83%AC%E3%83%99%E3%83%AB%E3%82%A2%E3%83%83%E3%83%97&format=eternal
F Change is a fan translation of Fチェンジ. The hand effect changes this card's Cost when you activate F Change; it does not itself grant a summon.

cards.flavorEn: The ultimate form of Kamen Rider Ex-Aid, achieved using the Hyper Muteki Gashat.
cards.flavorJa: 仮面ライダーエグゼイドがハイパームテキガシャットを使用した究極の姿。

cards.flavorEn: “If you keep pointing your purple blades toward our crimson skies, we will respond in kind.”
cards.flavorJa: 「紫の切っ先を我らの赤き空に向け続けるなら、相応の対応をさせてもらうぞ」
translationNotes: Unofficial English name, family names, and gameplay-text translation; the Japanese original and current rulings control.
Unofficial English name, family names, and gameplay-text translation; the Japanese original and current rulings control.

cards.flavorEn: The more eyes, the better. Better still if the eyes have legs and can run around.
cards.flavorJa: 目は多ければ多い方が良い。目に足がついて走り回るなら、さらに良い。
translationNotes: Unofficial English title and translation; Sukurusu is a romanization of スクルース.
Family mappings: 暗紫 = Dark Purple; 血醒 = Awakened Blood.

cards.flavorEn: You would be wise not to take that club head-on. Even if you can stop the club, you cannot stop the drool and spittle.
cards.flavorJa:
あの棍棒を正面から受け止めるのはやめた方がいいだろう。
棍棒を止めることができても涎や唾は止まらないからだ。
translationNotes: Unofficial English title and translation; Bugiruga is a romanization of ブギールガー.
Family mappings: 暗紫 = Dark Purple; 血醒 = Awakened Blood.
Unofficial English title and translation; ソウルバイト is rendered Soul Bite.
Family mapping: 血醒 = Awakened Blood.

cards.flavorEn: If you are captivated by those six arms, you will soon be ensnared. Your body, of course—and even your heart.
cards.flavorJa:
6本の腕に見とれていると、たちまち絡めとられてしまうだろう。
身体はもちろん、心でさえも。
translationNotes: Unofficial English title and translation; Nefira is a romanization of ネフィラー, and 婦長 is rendered Head Nurse.
Family mapping: 血醒 = Awakened Blood.
Succession is a cost reduction procedure; its printed reminder is translated here.

cards.flavorEn: You might defeat it before it takes in water. Though I have never seen anyone do so.
cards.flavorJa:
水を吸い込む前なら打ち倒せるかもしれない。
それができた者を見たことはないが。

cards.flavorEn: That hump is filled with anger, resolve, and an unwavering determination never to retreat.
cards.flavorJa: あのコブには怒りと覚悟、それに不退転の決意が詰まっているんだ。
translationNotes: Unofficial romanization of ラスヘッド; no official English spelling was established.

cards.flavorEn: Once scaleless and soft-bodied, it trained with firm resolve to protect its kin, until it gained an unyielding shell.
cards.flavorJa:
かつては鱗を持たず柔らかい身だったが、
同胞を守るために固い決意で鍛え上げ、堅固さを得るに至った。
translationNotes: モラモーラ is rendered as Mola Mola, the sunfish name.

cards.flavorEn: It is said that green water flowed from this rift and became the vast ocean. —From the Stranger's Travelogue
cards.flavorJa:
この裂け目から緑水が流れ出て、そして広大な海になったと言われている。
―異邦者の千里録より
translationNotes: 最奥 is translated as the Innermost Depths; 緑淵深 (printed reading: ryokuenshin) is translated as Green Abyss.
The ▶ preserves the printed activation condition: the revealed card must be returned to the bottom of the Deck to activate the draw effect.

cards.flavorEn: "Let us cast off our old, battered shells and don new ones."
cards.flavorJa: 「古く、傷ついた殻を捨て、新たな殻を纏うとしよう」

cards.flavorEn: "How fragile the land is. The day we fill this world with green water must be near."
cards.flavorJa: 「陸地のなんと脆いことか。この世界を緑水で満たす日も近かろう」

cards.flavorEn: A vast shadow commanding countless schools of fish. It is said that this single creature has the strength of an entire army.
cards.flavorJa:
数多の魚影を従える巨影。
ただ一体でありながら一軍に匹敵する戦力を持つという。
translationNotes: 深巣 (printed reading: shinsō) is translated as Deep Nest. Dantecreo is an unofficial romanization of ダンテクレオ.
The printed Succession reminder refers to removing EX Symbols; the English makes explicit the official manual’s rule that the cards bearing those symbols are removed from the game.

cards.flavorEn: How long has it been since I last saw people sharing like this? A feeling long forgotten seems to return. —From the Stranger’s Travelogue
cards.flavorJa:
こんな風に分け合う様子を見るのはいつ以来だろうか?
長い間忘れていた感覚がよみがえるようだ。
―異邦者の千里録より
translationNotes: Fierce Beast is a consistent fan translation of the 凶獣 family; an official English localization was not verified.
Fierce Beast is a consistent fan translation of the 凶獣 family; an official English localization was not verified.
The optional Nexus destruction changes the Cost limit when selecting the opposing Spirit, as in the printed text.

cards.flavorEn: A new light has kindled beneath the crimson clouds. Small and fleeting though it is, its radiance holds countless possibilities.
cards.flavorJa:
紅雲の下に新たな灯がともった。
小さく儚いが、その輝きは様々な可能性を秘めている。
translationNotes: Unofficial English name, family names, and gameplay-text translation; the Japanese original and current rulings control.
Fanciful proper name is rendered provisionally in Roman letters; no official English spelling is asserted.

cards.flavorEn: Anger and flame have something in common: neither ever runs out.
cards.flavorJa:
怒りと炎には共通点がある。
両方とも尽きるということがないのだ。
translationNotes: Unofficial English name, family names, and gameplay-text translation; the Japanese original and current rulings control.
Fanciful proper name is rendered provisionally in Roman letters; no official English spelling is asserted.

cards.flavorEn: Use the wind well, and your strength can multiply many times over. In this gorge, you will feel it for yourself.
cards.flavorJa: 風を上手く使えば何倍もの力を発揮できる。この谷ではそれを実感できるだろう。
translationNotes: Unofficial English name, family names, and gameplay-text translation; the Japanese original and current rulings control.

cards.flavorEn: The wind fans the flames, and the flames create wind with their heat. This cycle cannot be stopped.
cards.flavorJa:
風は炎の勢いを増し、炎はその熱で風を生み出す。
この連鎖を止めることはできない。
translationNotes: Unofficial English name, family names, and gameplay-text translation; the Japanese original and current rulings control.
The printed Succession reminder uses EX symbols as shorthand; this translation specifies the cards bearing those symbols, consistent with Standard comprehensive rule 12-2-1-3.

cards.flavorEn: "Make way! The great Sharky is coming through!"
cards.flavorJa: 「オラオラ!　シャーキー様のお通りだぜ!」

cards.flavorEn: With a spear and shield combined, what more could you ask for?
cards.flavorJa: 槍と盾が一体化しているなら言う事なしだ。
translationNotes: Unofficial romanization of モノカウル; no official English spelling was established.
